DeclaredIntent.main_action: 権威確定した正のマナ増加を身体外の供給→境界通過→身体内充填→定着→低明度余韻として示す。資源を再加算しない。
DeclaredIntent.main_objects: One existing beneficiary per render slot; two lobes are internal states of one mana phenomenon, not two physical objects or two events.
DeclaredIntent.background: Existing game background preserved. Preview compares two display clear colors; effect receives no background input.
DeclaredIntent.style: 2D anime-compatible game VFX, large colored planes and local luminous crests, no image textures
DeclaredIntent.text_logo_policy: No text/logos inside E. Diagnostic labels are outside the effect viewport.

ExpressionIntent.purpose: H64でマナの外部供給・境界通過・身体の受容/充填・終端を識別させる
must_communicate: Source stays outside the receiver until conversion.
Interior occupied area increases with received quantity.
Local emission is stronger than its colored material body.
Low-luminance afterglow remains body-owned, not a detached oval.
protected_relations: stored game resource is not lost when the E disappears

inferred_support_elements.allowed_scope: No independent new objects used. Requested VFX/SFX are newly designed; lobes and receiver response are attribute_resolved.

Good.evidence: Committed gain is not re-applied; world carrier is clipped outside the existing body and visual charge uses the same received amount.

Truth.coordinate_continuity: game coordinates converted to right-handed world; common orthographic transform for field and body
Truth.physical_causality: Declared fantasy bookkeeping, not a scientific claim about real mana or heat
Truth.state_transition_readability: Finite supply converts at boundary; stored state remains 1 after visible output fades

Beauty.boundary_readability: A bright 1.6 game-px transfer edge on a darker 3.4px support stroke at nonzero flux
Beauty.gaze_circulation: Exterior lobe to boundary to torso; second path from torso upper edge to later lobe; no mandatory closed loop
Beauty.structural_separation: Separate source surface, emitted radiance, body-clipped charge and source-bound bloom

PartitionPolicy.criterion: Independent body boundary, external transport, local conversion and stored state; not a split by scientific discipline or particle count.
PartitionPolicy.shared_condition_policy: actor time, coordinate transform and sampling are shared, but flux and stored state have different temporal responses.

PH1.name: Existing beneficiary and receiving silhouette
PH1.local_state_difference: Receiving torso boundary differs from face, arms and background; pose and transform are host-owned.
PH1.partition_reason: Existing body has its own geometric boundary, visibility and support state.

PH2.name: External finite mana flux
PH2.local_state_difference: Two asynchronous broad lobes carry a finite normalized amount; leading crest and colored body are distinct.
PH2.partition_reason: External carrier has independent transport history and exterior termination at PH1.

PH3.name: Boundary conversion interface
PH3.local_state_difference: Flux is nonzero only while the packet crosses PH1; the interface emits and lights the receiving surface.
PH3.partition_reason: Boundary conversion has a distinct location and derivative response, not the transport or stored amount.

PH4.name: Body-conformal acquired state
PH4.local_state_difference: Filled area grows monotonically as source is consumed; presentation dims later without draining stored mana.
PH4.partition_reason: Stored state and visible afterglow have histories independent of ongoing supply.

ScaleRegime.characteristic_length: H64 = 64 game px; 0.025 m/game px is a coordinate calibration assumption, not a measured game body height.

ScaleRegime.detail_cutoff: Broad fields and >=1.35px front at native H64; antialiasing and HDR filtering are design/implementation choices. See SamplingContract. Readability on a specific screen is not established without observation.
